task: ptrace compat — hard programs: fork+pipe stress test under --strict --verify
milestone: L2 determinism (hermit run --strict --verify, bitwise-identical) for a high-fork-volume concurrent-pipe fan-in stress program, ptrace backend
mode: run (NOT record; record is known to hang on concurrent pipes)
log_level: info (for the debug pass); default for the verify pass
note_branch: Exploratory compat probe; no hermit source change. Binary built at this SHA on origin/main lineage.

workload.pattern: each child writes 256 bytes of value (id+1) into its own pipe; parent poll()s all 16 read ends and drains, logging arrival order

results.arrival_order_signature: deterministic round-robin 1..16 repeating (sequentialized scheduler), vs host-scheduling coalescing natively

interpretation: A high-fork-volume concurrent-pipe fan-in — a historically-hard determinism case — is L2-deterministic in run mode on ptrace. The order-DEPENDENT digest (ORDERDIG) and full arrival order (ORDERHEAD) are bitwise-stable, so this is genuine scheduling determinism, not merely an order-independent checksum coincidence.
scope: ptrace, run mode only. record mode is separately known to hang on concurrent pipes (not retested here). Uses fork() (clone SIGCHLD), not vfork.
excluded_evidence: full 6348-line --log info dump (584 KB); info_excerpt.log holds the determinism-relevant subset
